profile.intro: I'm a fifth-year cybersecurity engineering student exploring security through technical internships, academic projects, research, and hands-on challenges.
profile.introFr: Je suis étudiante en cinquième année d'ingénierie en cybersécurité. J'explore la sécurité à travers des stages techniques, des projets académiques, la recherche et des défis pratiques.

projects.title: Container Security Assessment & Risk Monitoring
projects.desc: Docker container security assessment prototype: 15 deterministic controls, contextual risk scoring, runtime monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana, automated reporting, SHA-256 integrity verification and 32 passing automated tests.
projects.role: Designed and implemented the assessment, monitoring and reporting prototype; presented the internship work in an academic defense.
